scope: Successor source forensics for the open Realtime conversation-memory epistemic authority question. Resolve whether the direct Realtime memory reader preserves an explicit fact/claim/summary/inference distinction before returning rows to the model.

atoms.what_it_does: The dedicated gespraech_erinnerung table stores id, ts, subject, value and quelle. It has no explicit epistemic_class, transformation_class, observed_event_id, admission_id, privacy/retention tier or evidence-provenance fields beyond a free source label.
atoms.failure_mode: A verbatim user statement, model summary, model inference or false remembered claim can have the same structural row shape.

atoms.what_it_does: gespraech_erinnerung_lesen returns conversation-memory rows as {ts,subject,value,quelle}; for a non-empty query it also appends durable_memory rows into the same treffer list, labeling those only with quelle='durable_memory'. No explicit fact/observed/inferred/quoted/summary class is attached in this direct reader output.
atoms.failure_mode: The Realtime model can receive heterogeneous remembered claims and durable-memory material in a common retrieval shape where source name is the only visible distinction; source label alone does not establish factual authority or transformation provenance.
known_counterevidence: The dedicated conversation table is structurally separate from durable_memory, so storage authority is not literally collapsed at the database table boundary.

atoms.what_it_does: _tool_erinnerung_lesen dispatches stern gespraech-erinnerung-lesen directly; _tool_erinnerung_schreiben validates only non-empty subject/value and dispatches stern gespraech-erinnerung-schreiben with quelle=realtime-tool. No wrapper-level epistemic typing or deterministic MemoryAdmission is inserted in these paths.

hypothesis_update: For the direct Realtime memory tool path, the counterhypothesis that existing downstream retrieval already preserves an explicit claim-versus-fact epistemic distinction is not supported by the inspected source. The table separation is useful, but the returned model context remains epistemically under-typed.
counterhypotheses: Other non-Realtime retrieval paths may add stronger typing before using the same underlying rows; this packet does not generalize beyond the direct Realtime reader without auditing those consumers.
Prompts may verbally instruct the Realtime model to treat remembered content cautiously; prompt prose is weaker than typed data/admission and does not change the row semantics.
contradictions: TW5-CONTRADICTION-REALTIME-MEMORY-AUTHORITY-008 narrows: storage is separated from durable_memory, but the direct read/write tool bridge lacks explicit epistemic/admission typing and merges conversation and durable rows into a common retrieval shape.
triggerword4_required_delta: Define MemoryCandidate with immutable source_event_id/utterance_ref, source actor, transformation_class {VERBATIM, SUMMARY, INFERENCE, INSTRUCTION, OTHER}, epistemic_class {OBSERVED_CLAIM, INFERRED, UNKNOWN, VERIFIED_EXTERNAL where separately established}, generation, privacy/retention tier and content digest/reference.
Define deterministic MemoryAdmission that decides whether/how a candidate is persisted; model Function Calling proposes candidates but does not mint factual truth.
Readers return source + transformation + epistemic + provenance metadata and do not silently flatten conversation claims and canonical evidence into one fact-like context record.
Any promotion to canonical factual evidence requires independent admissible evidence; remembering that somebody said X is not evidence that X is true.
acceptance_tests_for_triggerword4: Persist a verbatim user utterance and a model summary of it; retrieval must distinguish them structurally, not only by text/source prose.
Persist a model inference through Realtime Function Calling; retrieval marks it INFERRED/MODEL_CANDIDATE and it cannot satisfy an OBSERVED/FACT evidence query.
Retrieve matching conversation-memory and durable-memory rows together; every returned item carries explicit provenance/epistemic class and downstream ranking cannot erase that class.
Sensitive spoken content rejected/redacted by policy leaves an auditable admission result without persisting disallowed raw content.

recommended_next_spans.reason: Trace claude_frage permission/process/host hook path after TaskAdmission and determine exact downstream effect enforcement.
Bound whether any other reader already adds epistemic typing before decisions; do not generalize this Realtime-reader result repository-wide without evidence.
